2026/02/25 Update:
it's been a few days so it makes sense to update on what's been happening, I've made a Subscribestar Adult account, which you can find here

https://subscribestar.adult/randotg

though you won't be able to subscribe just yet as the account is still waiting approval, but once it is, I'll make sure to update the page and all my koikatsu work will be available there.

besides that, due to the pause I've been spending my free time working on the Daz3d comic instead of the Koikatsu, and I'm currently close to 200 pages, if you like this comic, then I'm sure you will like that one as well, which will also be available on my subscribestar account once it is approved.

finally, many thanks to the people who send me messages, your concern is greatly appreciated :).
